title: API Availability & Liveness Probe
description: Verify that GET /health/live returns HTTP 200 with status alive and correct service metadata indicating process health.

title: API Dependency Health & Readiness Probe
description: Verify that GET /health/ready returns HTTP 200 with status ready, connected SQLite WAL database, mock auth active in dev, and 3/3 verified ONNX model artifacts.

title: Root Service Information & Versioning
description: Verify that GET / returns HTTP 200 with service name, release version, and operational phase details.

title: Authentication Token Verification
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/v1/auth/verify with a valid development/mock Bearer token returns HTTP 200 with authenticated user identity and role assignment.

title: Unauthenticated Request Rejection
description: Verify that requests to protected endpoints (/api/v1/v1/auth/me, /api/v1/v1/detections) without an Authorization header or with an invalid token strictly return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

title: RBAC Authorization & Admin Endpoint Protection
description: Verify that standard user accounts attempting to access admin endpoints (/api/v1/v1/admin/incidents, /api/v1/v1/admin/operations/verify-models) are rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

title: SMS Smishing Telemetry Ingestion (Synthetic Threat)
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/v1/detections ingests a high-risk synthetic smishing event (e.g. urgent account suspension alert) with risk score 88, persists threat metadata without raw text, and returns HTTP 201 Created.

title: SMS Legitimate Telemetry Ingestion (Synthetic Benign)
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/v1/detections ingests a low-risk synthetic benign event (e.g. appointment reminder) with risk score 12, persists threat metadata, and returns HTTP 201 Created.

title: Telemetry Deduplication via Device Detection ID
description: Verify that submitting the same device_detection_id to POST /api/v1/v1/detections acts idempotently without creating duplicate database records.

title: QR-Decoded Malicious URL Reputation Lookup
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/v1/threat-intel/lookup with a synthetic malicious QR URL (e.g. http://malicious-secure-login.top/verify) returns HTTP 200 with classification, reputation score, and threat indicators.

title: QR-Decoded Benign URL Reputation Lookup
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/v1/threat-intel/lookup with a benign URL (e.g. https://google.com) returns HTTP 200 confirming clean reputation.

title: Invalid Payload & Schema Validation Handling
description: Verify that sending malformed JSON, missing required fields, or out-of-bound risk scores to POST /api/v1/v1/detections returns HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity with structured validation error details.

title: Threat History Retrieval & Pagination
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/v1/detections returns a paginated list of user threat detection records sorted by creation timestamp.

title: User Threat Defensive Action Recording
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/v1/detections/{detection_id}/action records a defensive user mitigation action (BLOCK_SENDER or COPY_SAFE_LINK) and returns HTTP 200.

title: SOC Incident Creation by Admin
description: Verify that an authenticated admin user can create a security incident via POST /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents with title, severity (CRITICAL), and summary, returning HTTP 201 Created.

title: SOC Incident Lifecycle Transition
description: Verify that PATCH /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents/{incident_id}/status transitions incident status from OPEN to INVESTIGATING to RESOLVED, rejecting invalid state transitions with HTTP 400.

title: User Feedback & False Positive Submission
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/v1/feedback allows submitting classification feedback with comments and feedback type, returning HTTP 201 Created.

title: Cryptographic AI Model Integrity Verification
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/v1/admin/operations/verify-models audits SHA-256 hashes of TinyBERT, XGBoost, and Isolation Forest against MODEL_MANIFEST.json and returns 100% verified status.
